scope: Local commutation of the Lee--Wald radical-leaf quotient and lifted-SO(3) zero-level reduction on every smooth constant-corank fixed-occupation stratum of candidates 17, 18 and 20.

commands: python3 -m py_compile on the producer, independent verifier and focused test
python3 -m json.tool on the certificate and schema
git diff --check on the scoped theorem paths

independent_rail.method: The verifier does not import the producer. It re-hashes every source, independently imports the phase-reduced candidate coverage, and checks the universal radical-annihilation identity on an exact rank-four presymplectic model.

adversarial.mutation: Promote global_rotation_zero_fibre_connected from false to true.
adversarial.result: The schema rejects the promotion; the focused test requires the rejection.

tier_2.reason: The certificate pins the phase-reduced divisor theorem, the exact lifted stabilizer and the six exact rotation-zero witnesses. No mathematical input outside that content-addressed chain is promoted.

tier_3.reason: This is a local constant-corank proof-architecture gate, not a programme freeze, global quotient theorem or shared-core algebra change.

claim_boundary: CERTIFIED only on smooth constant-corank fixed-occupation strata after common node-phase reduction. Global connectedness, Hausdorff leaf topology, singular and occupation gluing, final residual descent, all-orders integration and causal, observational or quantum transport remain fail-closed.
